All-in-one flightstick (grip + base). Buttons as the CDT-AERO-R grip. Correction 2026-10: earlier entry called SLDR the grip lever and rZ the right base lever; inputs kept, control names fixed to the sheet. The older AEROMAX template (classic/Cadet firmware, article 47001275883) numbers differently: 1/2 trigger stages, 3/4 flip trigger up/down, a MODE switch with hats on 13-24 (mode 1) / 25-36 (mode 2); check which layout the device's profile uses.

Three swappable hat positions: lower thumb hat 14-18, side hat 19-23, rear hat 24-28 (press = 14/19/24). Factory caps (older sheet + product page): lower and side are 2-way hats (up/down only), rear is a push button; left/right (and all rear directions) only exist with the supplied 4-way caps. The OLDER official sheet (article 47001263911, Dec 2024, linked from the product page; also used by the sc-mapper community templates) numbers differently: 1 and 7 head buttons, 2-6 top hat, 8 ministick push, 9-13 lower hat, 14-18 rear hat, 19 pinky button, 20-24 side hat, 25/26 front flip lever up/pull, 27/28 two-stage trigger, 29 autopilot trigger under the head, 30 brake lever click, SR brake axis. Check which layout the device's profile uses.

devices.name: Virpil VPC MongoosT-50 Grip (original; Standard, BE Black Edition, CM "Standard Upgraded")

identify.note: Discontinued first-generation MongoosT-50 grip (2016-2019, replaced by the MongoosT-50CM2 grip). Control set from the product page: 1 dual-stage trigger, 1 folding trigger, 5 buttons (one is the red fire button), 3 x 4-way hats, 1 x 2-position switch (index-side), 1 analog brake lever; the CM2 page says the original grip had 23 bindable buttons. Editions: VPC MongoosT-50 Grip (standard), MongoosT-50BE (Black Edition, black buttons/hats/palm rest), MongoosT-50CM (Russian labels, remodelled brake lever, flip trigger and buttons); same control set. The standard and CM product photos are no longer on Virpil's media server; the image is the BE grip.
